What is Motion?

AI calendar and task manager that automatically schedules every task into your calendar around meetings, deadlines and priorities, and continuously reshuffles the plan when something changes or slips.

Best for

Automatically fitting a heavy task list into a fragmented calendar.

Main features

  • Automatic task scheduling into real calendar time slots
  • continuous rescheduling when meetings or delays occur
  • deadline-aware prioritisation with warnings when a deadline becomes unachievable
  • project management with auto-assigned work
  • meeting booking pages
  • AI Notetaker
  • AI Employees (agents for sales, recruiting and support workflows added in 2025-26)
  • team workload balancing.

Practical use cases

  • Deciding what to work on right now without re-planning manually
  • protecting deep-work blocks against meeting creep
  • seeing immediately that a deadline is unachievable given current commitments
  • balancing work across a small team.

Who is it for?

  • Executives, consultants, agency staff, founders and anyone with more committed work than available hours.

Pricing, free access & limits

Per-seat subscription

Plans described in the source

Pro/Individual around $34/mo billed monthly or roughly $19-29/mo billed annually. Business/Team around $20-40/user/mo annually depending on tier. Enterprise custom. Motion has repositioned pricing several times as it added AI Employees, which are priced as additional seats or usage. Verify current tiers.

Free plan

No free plan.

Free trial

Yes - 7-day free trial, card typically required.

Usage limits to consider

Scheduling quality depends on accurate task duration estimates. AI Employee usage may be metered separately. Seat-based with no free tier.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The auto-scheduling is genuinely differentiated - it answers 'what should I do now' with a defensible answer based on real calendar capacity
  • the deadline-impossible warning is uncomfortable and useful
  • removes the daily re-planning ritual entirely.

Limitations to consider

  • Expensive for an individual productivity tool
  • requires total commitment - partial adoption produces a wrong plan and the tool becomes noise
  • task duration estimates must be realistic or scheduling degrades
  • the UI is dense and the learning curve is real
  • English only
  • the recent pivot toward AI Employees has muddied the product focus.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Chrome extension

Languages

  • English interface

API access

Yes - Motion API available

Integrations and exports

  • Google Calendar, Outlook/Microsoft 365 Calendar, iCloud Calendar, Zoom, Slack, Zapier, Gmail

Evaluation notes

Motion only works if every commitment lives in it - half-adoption is worse than not using it at all. Budget a two-week onboarding period before judging value, and be honest about duration estimates.
